thread:
sara_cs: Quick dump from today's customer workshop — captured the raw asks and a few recurring pain points. Keeping it short so we can triage.
sara_cs: Top three customer asks (synthesized):\n• per-endpoint cost tagging (customers want to tag endpoints/apps for chargebacks, more granular than current service-level).\n• prompt versioning + easy rollback (dev teams want to pin prompts/eval sets and revert changes without redeploy).\n• ephemeral upload sessions with auto-purge for regulated data (healthcare/legal teams).

sara_cs: Noted pain points: console is confusing on session lifecycle, limited trace of who triggered a fallback model, and support turnaround for onboarding docs (esp billing/export).

mike_pm: This is gold, thanks. My initial prioritization:\n1) per-endpoint cost tagging — high (revenue ops + renewals are asking).\n2) prompt versioning — medium-high (reduces regression risk).\n3) ephemeral sessions — medium (compliance sell-in).\nCan @leo_analytics run a quick dollars-in-play for per-endpoint? also can we put these into the product backlog today?

jamal_eng: From infra POV: per-endpoint tagging needs schema + metrics pipeline changes and a migration path for existing events. Rough: 2 focused sprints to get tagging + reporting.\nPrompt versioning is mostly metadata + minor runtime changes to pin model/prompt hashes — lower effort but needs rollout UI.

nina_support: We're seeing repeat tickets about rollbacks — sample ticket: <https://support.redwood.example/ticket/8791>. Onboarding docs gap: customers keep missing the "session retention" setting during setup.

leo_analytics: I can estimate ARR impact tomorrow. Quick ask: @sara_cs — can you drop attendee list + which customers requested per-endpoint tagging so I can weight it?

sara_cs: Pasting raw notes from workshop (verbatim):\n- "Need to attribute cost to product teams, not models" (finance lead)\n- "We broke prod after prompt tweak, rolling back was manual and slow" (platform eng)\n- "Uploads with PHI — we can't keep them around longer than 24h" (compliance)\n- "Console doesn't show which route triggered a fallback, we only see model name" (SRE)\n- "Billing csv lacks an app id column" (ops)

mike_pm: Good quotes. I'll create a distilled Notion page for prioritization and link the backlog tickets. If this lands as epics, we can scope SLO impact and delivery windows. :thumbsup:

notion-bot: Notion page created: <https://notion.so/redwood/3123470001-customer-workshop-asks> by mike_pm

jamal_eng: Quick technical note: for per-endpoint tagging we should add an immutable endpoint id to request metadata (affects SDKs). That gives us reliable joins in analytics. Will add a tech spike to evaluate SDK changes.

nina_support: I'll start curating ticket samples for the rollback flow and the upload retention ask. Will drop them into the Notion page by EOD.

leo_analytics: On it — will return numbers by tomorrow noon. If anyone has ARR estimates per account, DM me.

sara_cs: Thanks all. Next steps: mike creates Notion epic (done), jamal schedules tech spike, leo runs ARR impact, nina curates tickets. We'll reconvene Fri sprint planning.
